description: Works out the figures a small company's FRS 102 section 1A accounts take, from the open DIYA-GL book: this year's profit and loss account and balance sheet lines, last year's balance sheet from the opening balance, the tangible fixed asset note by class, the period dates, the company number and name, the directors and the employee count, in whole pounds with every subtotal holding. The book holds no profit and loss account for last year, so none is given. Use this when the person asks what their small company accounts will show or for their full year-end accounts figures. It refuses a book whose balance sheets do not balance, and it does not file the accounts or contact Companies House.
name: derive_small_company_accounts
title: Derive small-company accounts
